title: Tales of the Teen Titans #55 DC 1985 Deathstroke Cover Changeling Wolfman
condition_description: Front cover bright and clean. Small chip/scuff at the left edge of the back cover, light toning. See photos.
description:
Tales of the Teen Titans #55 (July 1985), DC Comics - "Changeling Against the Terminator." Deathstroke cover by Eduardo Barreto. Written by Marv Wolfman, art by Ron Randall. DC 50th anniversary cover logo. 75 cent cover price.

Back cover: Kenner Super Powers Collection action figure ad.

Condition: front cover bright and clean with light wear. Small chip/scuff at the left edge of the back cover and light toning on the back (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
